description: Director: Noah Segan Run Time: 88 min. Release Year: 2026 Starring: Giancarlo Esposito, Jamie Lee Curtis, John Turturro, Steve Buscemi, Will Price Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

description: A cherished holiday tradition for nearly two decades, Into the Light weaves together giant puppets, global dance, and live music in a joyful celebration of winter traditions from around the world. Presented by The Vanaver Caravan and Arm-of-the-Sea Theater, the production highlights holidays such as Kwanzaa, Diwali, Christmas, Chanukah, Sankta Lucia, Yule, and the Winter Solstice — honoring the many cultural ways people bring light, joy, and togetherness to the colder months. Blending Arm-of-the-Sea Theater’s striking puppetry with The Vanaver Caravan’s vibrant world-dance repertoire, Into the Light reminds us that community is the warmth that carries us through winter.

address: 1000 Mountain Rest Road, New Paltz, NY 12561
description: Artist FRANC PALAIA will present a selection of SX-70 photographs of Italy. The photos range from 3"x3" to 36"x36". The award winning artist, Palaia blends photography with painting and will demonstrate his original technique of hand coloring the SX-70 Polaroids which result in his photographs look like miniature oil paintings. He enlarges the original small Polaroids to a 3'x3' scale where the small hand colored blending of his oil based crayons end up looking like broad painted brushstrokes of a painting. The colors are brilliant, textured and dynamic and enhance the beauty of Italy.

description: With over 20 years of career and six studio albums, Las Migas have become one of the most internationally acclaimed Spanish bands. They have performed in more than 50 countries, including the United States, India, France, Egypt, Mexico, Cuba, Italy, Namibia, Jamaica, Algeria, Hong Kong, Germany, Chile, Sweden, Ukraine, and Morocco, among many others. They have been nominated three times for the Latin Grammy Award in the Best Flamenco Album category (2016, 2022, and 2024), winning the award in 2022. description: Explore the Hudson River’s surprising role in the American Revolution with Tides of War, a special exhibition at the Hudson River Maritime Museum. description: Celebrate the folk music tradition of Veracruz at the Ashokan Center’s Ariles Son Jarocho Camp—the first festival of its kind in the U.S. Experience the music, dance, tapping and clapping that are son jarocho’s signatures. Come share your talent or simply enjoy the magic of the night. Let’s celebrate the power of self-expression together! This fun community night will continue every third Tuesday of the month. FREE Admission with the purchase of a snack or drink. Sign up via the link here or in our bio on Instagram or our FB Homepage —it’s first-come, first-served if you don’t. 10% off purchases for performers! BYOB.

title: Electrical Apprentice Program
description: This month, the Ulster BOCES Adult Career Education Center will open its enrollment for its rigorous electrical apprentice training program. This 900-hour program will be completed over the duration of four-school years. The program begins at the end of August and runs through the following June. Students attend class two nights per week, accruing 225 hours of instruction each year.

title: Power Yoga Classes in Kingston
description: Power Yoga is a breath-led vinyasa flow blending elements of Ashtanga with creative, fluid sequencing. Expect continuous movement that builds strength, flexibility, and stamina, often settling into a steady, meditative rhythm. Classes are set to music, in a gently heated room, and students are encouraged to move intuitively, follow their breath, and make the practice their own. Every Wednesday & Friday, 6–7:00 pm. All levels welcome! Located first floor Assembly building.

title: Gentle Hatha Yoga with Wendy
description: Gentle Hatha Yoga with an emphasis on back care in our beautiful upstairs studio with views of the forest and mountains. Wendy trained in Pondicherry, India and has been teaching for years. Mats provided.

title: SUNY New Paltz Department of Theatre Arts: "Twelfth Night"
when: Fri., Feb. 26, 8 p.m., Sat., Feb. 27, 8 p.m., Sun., Feb. 28, 2 p.m., Thu., March 4, 8 p.m., Fri., March 5, 8 p.m., Sat., March 6, 8 p.m. and Sun., March 7, 2 p.m.
venue: Parker Theatre at SUNY New Paltz
description: Twelfth Night by William Shakespeare is a fast-paced romantic comedy with several interwoven plots of romance, mistaken identities, practical jokes and music. Separated from her twin brother Sebastian in a shipwreck, Viola disguises herself as a boy, calls herself Cesario, and becomes a servant to the Duke Orsino. He sends her to woo the Countess Olivia on his behalf, but the Countess falls in love with Cesario. Meanwhile Olivia’s uncle, Sir Toby Belch, gets drunk with his friend Sir Andrew Aguecheek and they play a trick on Malvolio, Olivia’s steward. Sebastian eventually appears, causing even more confusion, chaos, and comedy.

description: The Woodstock Celtic Session is a weekly gathering of Traditional musicians who come together to enjoy and play Irish music and more in an unplugged, casual, pub setting. We've been playing together since 2002! Musicians versed in Irish Trad are welcome to join in.

title: Tuesday Night Group Meditation
description: Regular meditation practice can help settle your mind; you become more peaceful, feel more centered, experience a greater sense of wellbeing. Practitioners often find it beneficial to meditate together in community, jointly increasing their depth of focus and comfort in their meditation practice. Our Tuesday night gatherings provide exactly this opportunity. The evening is free and open to all, but reservations are required for each session.

title: FORREST YOGA with Cindeelu , Wednesdays 5pm-6pm
address: 307 Wall St Ground Floor, Kingston, NY 12401
description: Ascensed Academy offers Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Yoga and Functional Training classes 6 days a week. W E D N E S D A Y 5:00-6:00 PM FORREST YOGA with Cindeelu ​Forrest Yoga is a therapeutically-oriented, can be physically intense (to be adjusted to where you are each day). This practice address modern-day physical and emotional stresses. You will be invited to long holds of poses, deep abdominal core work, and a to focus within through breath and sensation. title: Qigong: Meditation, Movement & Meaning
description: During this turning of the seasons, we can feel vulnerable as the weather unexpectedly changes from warm to cold, from dry to damp, windy to still, and back again. For the next several weeks I will be teaching a form comprised of gentle, easy to follow movements from each of the phases of Traditional Chinese Medicine that nourish and protect the yin organs: liver, heart, spleen, lung, kidney – and their yang counterparts. These classes will support us through the seasonal changes and prepare us for the holiday season nourished, balanced and fortified in body, mind and spirit

title: Gameshow Trivia at The Six Bells

description: Trivia coming to The Festhers Tavern in the Six Bells Countryside Inn in Rosendale, NY Thursdays starting June 25, hosted by Trevor from Hudson Valley Trivia Co (Voted best trivia night 2024-25)! assemble your trivia-loving friends and get ready to laugh, test your wits and win some prizes for buzzer trivia at the historic @thesixbells! description: Wrap up your work week with this open-level vinyasa yoga class. This class incorporates elements of breathwork and meditation to encourage strength, stability, and flexibility of both mind and body. You will leave feeling grounded, refreshed, and more deeply connected to yourself.

title: Yoga on the Farm With Eric Murphy
rawCategory: Health & Wellness, Outdoors & Recreation, Workshops & Classes
description: Join us for a weekly outdoor yoga session surrounded by open skies, birdsong, and the earthy charm of the farm. Please bring your own mat, and blanket and come ready to stretch, breathe, and connect with the land. All levels welcome! $10 Suggested Donation Every Saturday Beginning June 7th (weather permitting) Visit seedsongfarm.org/events for more info and updates.
